source_refs.note: Exercise 14.3, Question 1 (i)-(iv): a x b and b x a by the determinant formula, checked by dot products (book p.282). Answer key PDF 312.

blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Compute the cross product \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) and \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\). Check your answer by showing that each \(\underline{a}\) and \(\underline{b}\) are perpendicular to \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) and \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\). \(\underline{a} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh seedha cross product nikalne ka sawal hai, saath mein jawab khud check karna hai.
Humein \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) dono chahiye.
Plan: pehle determinant se \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\), phir sab signs badal kar \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\), aur aakhir mein dot product se perpendicular hone ki tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\underline{a} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - \underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} = \underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\), phir check karna hai ke dono vectors in par perpendicular hain.
Tareeqa: Jab vectors components (\(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\) wali shakal) mein diye hon to cross product ka sab se aasaan rasta 14.3.5 wala determinant formula hai. \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) ke liye qaida \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a} = -(\underline{a} \times \underline{b})\) kaafi hai. Perpendicular check karne ke liye dot product lenge: zero aaye to perpendicular.

Determinant likhein
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 2 & 1 & -1 \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Pehli row mein unit vectors \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\), doosri row mein pehle vector ke components \(\underline{a}\), teesri row mein doosre vector ke components \(\underline{b}\). Rows ki tarteeb wohi honi chahiye jo product ki tarteeb hai, warna jawab ka sign ulta ho jayega.

Teenon minors nikalein
\[\underline{i}\text{ minor} = (1)(1) - (-1)(-1) = 0\]
\[\underline{j}\text{ minor} = (2)(1) - (-1)(1) = 3\]
\[\underline{k}\text{ minor} = (2)(-1) - (1)(1) = -3\]
Kyun: Har unit vector ki row aur column ko dhak dein (cover kar dein); jo 2 by 2 bachta hai us ka (upar baayan)(neeche daayan) minus (upar daayan)(neeche baayan) minor hai. Har product ko bracket mein likhne se negative signs ki ghalti nahi hoti.

Signs \(+, -, +\) lagayein
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{i}(0) - \underline{j}(3) + \underline{k}(-3)\]
\[= -3\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Determinant ko pehli row ke saath kholte waqt signs ka pattern \(+, -, +\) hota hai, yani beech wala \(\underline{j}\) ka term minus ho kar aata hai.
Dhyan dein: Sab se zyada ghalti isi beech wale minus mein hoti hai; \(-\underline{j}(\text{minor})\) mein minor khud negative ho to jawab plus ban jata hai.

Ab \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) nikalein
\[\underline{b} \times \underline{a} = -(\underline{a} \times \underline{b})\]
\[= 3\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Dobara poora determinant banane ki zaroorat nahi. Vectors ki jagah badalne se determinant ki row 2 aur row 3 aapas mein badal jati hain, aur do rows badalne se determinant ka sign ulta ho jata hai. Is liye cross product commutative (jagah badalne se same) nahi hai: \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a} = -(\underline{a} \times \underline{b})\). Har component ka sign badal dein, bas.

Tasdeeq: \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) par perpendicular hain
\[\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b}) = (2)(0) + (1)(-3) + (-1)(-3)\]
\[= 0 - 3 + 3 = 0\]
\[\underline{b} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b}) = (1)(0) + (-1)(-3) + (1)(-3)\]
\[= 0 + 3 - 3 = 0\]
Kyun: Cross product ki pehchaan hi yeh hai ke woh dono vectors par perpendicular (amood, 90 degree par) hota hai. Do non-zero vectors tab hi perpendicular hote hain jab un ka dot product zero ho. Dono jagah zero aaya, is liye hamara cross product sahi hai. Agar yahan zero na aata to samajh lein ke minors ya signs mein kahin ghalti hai.

\(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) ke saath tasdeeq
\[\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{b} \times \underline{a}) = -\,\underline{a} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b}) = 0\]
\[\underline{b} \cdot (\underline{b} \times \underline{a}) = -\,\underline{b} \cdot (\underline{a} \times \underline{b}) = 0\]
Kyun: \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) sirf \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) ka ulta (negative) hai, yani wohi line, sirf rukh ulta. Zero ko minus se multiply karein to zero hi rehta hai, is liye \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a}\) par bhi perpendicular hain.
blocks.final_answer: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = -3\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{b} \times \underline{a} = 3\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\); dono dot products zero hain, is liye \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono in par perpendicular hain.
